import itertools
from pysat.formula import CNF
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

# Setup variables
n = 22
vars = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
var_count = 1
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        vars[i][j] = var_count
        var_count += 1

cnf = CNF()

# No red K5: for every 5 verts, at least one blue edge (positive literal)
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
    edge_vars = [vars[a][b] for a, b in itertools.combinations(comb, 2)]
    cnf.append(edge_vars)

# No blue K4: for every 4 verts, at least one red edge (negative literal)
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    edge_vars = [vars[a][b] for a, b in itertools.combinations(comb, 2)]
    cnf.append([-v for v in edge_vars])

solver.append_formula(cnf.clauses)
